final_trifecta_product_kpi.definition: latest pre-race selected trifecta ticket set per race

full_ticket_return_department.scope: latest eligible pre-close frozen portfolio; full main and hole tickets
limitations: 旧戦略と混合しない。部署追加前の予想を事後生成しない。
回収率120%の単純超過だけで購入許可しない。外部検証が必要。
未確定・公式払戻未取得は成績から除外。

timestamp_verified_live_evidence.scope: prediction timestamp strictly before known close time
timestamp_verified_live_evidence.limitations: Legacy rows are timestamp checks, not a reconstructed immutable archive.

annual_specialist_knowledge.policy: full archive retained; adaptive previous 1/2/3 calendar years weighted 1/.5/.25 for all riders; same-day/future results excluded
limitations: 脚質と決まり手を区別。決まり手・行動の未取得分は推測しない。
部署予想は暫定の影予想。実戦検証前に本番モデルを置換しない。

live_snapshot_learning.policy: one closest model-ready real pre-race snapshot per race/player/time bucket; labels joined only after official history is available

second_pick_shadow_rule.promotion_requirement: must beat production prospectively on >=300 settled races and pass external validation

strategist_recommendations.action: treat latest selected trifecta tickets as the primary product KPI; keep model Top10 coverage as a diagnostic KPI
freeze automatic model promotion and investigate shifted/missing live features before changing production
freeze automatic weight promotion; require shadow validation before production changes
optimize ticket logic against live 10-point hit rate as a separate KPI from Top1 accuracy
keep the current best challenger in shadow until the 300-race promotion floor is reached
continue prospective shadow testing of the best second-pick reversal rule; no live switch until promotion criteria pass

evidence.promotion_requirement: must beat production prospectively on >=300 settled races and pass external validation

strategist_recommendations.action: keep multi-head coverage for near-tie races; do not collapse to a single head

decision_rule: production changes require validation evidence; auxiliary history creates hypotheses but cannot promote itself
